blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.
blocks.zh: 文学研究语言代理人正在成为生命科学科学助理的一个标准组成部分,但几乎没有什么可控制的证据可以证明他们掌握的哪一部分很重要。 我们用活生生的PubMed API作为唯一的工具,对生物医学权利要求进行控制性核查。 拥有固定的主干线和输出格式,我们比较了四个取景器:闭门簿回答,单发回取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 直观的一发取回只找到6%的金币,在不提高准确性的情况下,将过度自信的错误变成弃权. 让该模型自己提出三重质询,并得出最佳判断(准确度为62%,其他现实的取材机为49-59%),尽管这些差异在我们样本规模上并不显著,代理商使用的搜索预算不到一半。 有了"黄金摘要",同一种模型达到了79-86%的准确度,一个显著的17-24分差距表明取回而不是推理是主要的瓶颈. 最后,一项引用审计显示,封闭账号模型引用了几乎始终存在的PubMed身份证(327/335),但几乎永远不相关:跨家庭的LLM法官认为,现有327起引用中只有3起与索赔有关,而搜索代理商提供的引用率为67%。 因此,对科学代理人的检查不足。 我们在https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers发布代码、提示和所有缓存工具呼叫。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language agents that search the biomedical literature are quickly becoming a default component of scientific assistants: they formulate queries, read abstracts, and return verdicts with citations ( Lála et al., 2023 ; Skarlinski et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) . The design space of such harnesses is large, but the empirical basis for choosing among designs is thin. Three questions arise for anyone building a literature agent for the life sciences:
(i) Does giving a frontier model access to PubMed improve its verdicts over closed-book answering, or does parametric knowledge suffice?
(ii) Is an agentic loop, in which the model writes and refines its own queries ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Nakano et al., 2021 ) , worth its additional cost over a fixed one-shot retrieval pipeline ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) ?
(iii) When agents cite papers, are those citations faithful to what they actually read?
blocks.zh:
搜寻生物医学文献的语文代理人正在迅速成为科学助理的默认组成部分:他们提出询问、阅读摘要并用引文回复判决(Lála等,2023;Skarlinski等,2024;Jin等,2024)。 此类吊带的设计空间很大,但在设计中选择的经验基础很薄. 对于任何建立生命科学文献代理人的人来说,有三个问题:
(一) 允许边疆模型进入PubMed是否改进了对闭门簿答复的判断,还是仅凭辅助知识即可?
(二)一个代理环,模型在其中写出并细化了自己的查询(姚等,2023;中野等,2021),是否值得通过固定的一发取回管来增加成本(刘易斯等,2020)?
(三) 代理人引用文件时,引用文件是否忠实于他们实际阅读的内容?

blocks.en: We study these questions in a controlled setting: expert-written biomedical claim verification on SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) , using the live PubMed E-utilities API as the only tool. We hold the backbone model, prompt format, and output schema fixed and vary only the harness : closed-book, single-shot retrieval, a ReAct-style multi-query agent, and an oracle that receives the gold abstracts. We run the same protocol with two backbones and decompose errors into retrieval failures (the gold paper was never seen) and reasoning failures (the gold paper was seen but the verdict was wrong).
blocks.zh: 我们以一个可控的环境来研究这些问题:专家撰写的关于SciFact(Wadden等,2020年)的生物医学索赔核实,将活的PubMed E-Unitities API作为唯一的工具. 我们持有主干模型,即时格式,输出计划 固定和改变 仅使用: 封闭的书,单发取回, 一种ReAct式的多克特剂, 和一个接收黄金摘要的神谕。 我们用两个主干线运行同样的协议,并将错误分解为检索失败(从未见过金纸)和推理失败(金纸被看到但判决错误).

blocks.en: (1) A small, fully reproducible harness-ablation protocol for literature agents built on a public benchmark and a public API (code and cached tool calls released). (2) An empirical comparison of four harnesses across two backbones, with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired analyses. (3) A citation audit showing how closed-book models cite real but irrelevant papers, a failure mode that existence-based checks alone cannot catch.
blocks.zh: (1)基于公共基准和公开API(发布代码和缓存工具呼叫)的文献代理商小而可完全再生的取用-提取协议. (2) 对跨越两个主干线的4个接头进行实证比较,并有靴子置信间隔和对接分析。 (3)引用审计,显示封闭账本模型如何引用真实而无关的纸张,这种失败模式,仅基于存在的检查是无法捕获的.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Scientific claim verification. SciFact ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) introduced expert-written claims paired with evidence abstracts; subsequent systems such as MultiVerS ( Wadden et al., 2022 ) operate over a fixed corpus of about 5K abstracts. We instead place the model in the open-world setting it would face in deployment, searching all of PubMed. Retrieval-augmented and agentic biomedical QA. MedRAG ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) benchmarks retrieval-augmented generation for medical QA, GeneGPT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) teaches LLMs to call NCBI APIs, and PaperQA/PaperQA2 ( Lála et al., 2023 ; Skarlinski et al., 2024 ) build full literature agents. LAB-Bench ( Laurent et al., 2024 ) evaluates biology-research capabilities including literature tasks. These works typically evaluate full systems; our aim is a minimal, controlled ablation of the harness itself. Citation fabrication. LLMs are known to fabricate bibliographic references ( Walters and Wilder, 2023 ) . We extend this analysis to PubMed IDs and distinguish non-existent citations from existing but irrelevant ones.
blocks.zh: 科学索赔核实。 SciFact(Wadden等,2020年)引入了与证据摘要配对的由专家撰写的索赔;而之后的系统如MultiVerS(Wadden等,2022年)运行在一个约5K摘要的固定体上. 相反,我们把模型放在开放世界的设置中, 它将会面对部署, 搜索所有的PubMed。 取出-取出和代理生物医学QA. MedraG(Xiong等,2024年)为医疗QA的基准检索-增强生成,GeneGPT(Jin等,2024年)教LLMs调用NCBI APIS,和PaperQA2(Lála等,2023年;Skarlinski等,2024年)建立完整的文献代理. LAB-Bench(Laurent等,2024年)评价生物学研究能力,包括文学任务. 这些作品典型地评价了整个系统;我们的目标是对绳子本身进行最小的、有控制的破坏。 引用编造. 已知LLMS编造了参考书目(Walters and Wilder,2023.). 我们把这一分析扩大到PubMed身份证,并将不存在的引用与现有的但无关的引用区分开来。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: Task and data. Each SciFact claim is labeled Support , Contradict , or Not Enough Info (NEI) with respect to its cited abstracts. Because SciFact test labels are hidden, we use the labeled dev split (300 claims) and, due to computational budget constraints, evaluate a fixed random sample of N = 100 N{=}100 claims (seed 0), shared by all conditions. We report accuracy and macro-F1 over the three labels, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (2,000 resamples).
blocks.zh: 任务与数据. 每项SciFact索赔在其所引用摘要中均被标为“支持”、“矛盾”或“信息不足”。 由于SciFact测试标签被隐藏,我们使用被标注为dev分(300个索赔),并由于计算预算限制,评价一个固定随机抽样的N=100个NQQ100索赔(种子0),所有条件共享. 我们从三个标签上报告精确度和宏F1,95%的靴子置信间隔(2 000个复标)。

blocks.en: Harnesses. All conditions share the same instructions and require a JSON output { label , cited_pmids , rationale }, at temperature 0. • Closed-book : the model answers from parametric knowledge and may cite PMIDs it believes are relevant. • Single-shot RAG : the claim, with stopwords removed, is issued as one PubMed query (relevance sort, top-5). If PubMed returns nothing (terms are ANDed), we relax to an OR over content words. Titles and abstracts (truncated to 1,500 characters) are given to the model. • Agentic search : a ReAct-style loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) in which, at each step, the model either issues a PubMed query of its own design or answers. It has a budget of 4 searches (top-5 each, deduplicated) and is told PubMed’s query semantics. • Oracle : the model receives the SciFact-cited gold abstracts directly. This upper-bounds performance given perfect retrieval and isolates reasoning over evidence.
blocks.zh: 调和. 所有条件都使用相同的指令,并要求在温度下使用 JSON 输出 { 标签,引用_ pmids, 原理} 0. 封闭本:模型从参数化知识中解答,并可以引用其认为相关的PMID。 · 单发RAG:索赔以PubMed查询方式(关联类,上至5个)发布,并去掉止字。 如果 PubMed 不返回任何内容( 术语为Anded), 我们放松到 OR 上的内容单词 。 标题和摘要(共1500个字符)交给了模型. • Agentic search :一个ReAct-style回路(Yao等,2023年),在回路中,每一步,车型都发出自己设计的PubMed查询或回答. 它的预算为4个搜索(每个搜索上5个,被破译),并被告知PubMed的查询语义. ^ Oracle:模型直接接收由SciFact所引用的"黄金摘要". 这种上行性能给出了完美的检索并隔离了对证据的推理.

blocks.en: Closed-book : the model answers from parametric knowledge and may cite PMIDs it believes are relevant.
blocks.zh: close-book :模型解答来自参数化知识,并可能引用其认为相关的PMID.

blocks.en: Single-shot RAG : the claim, with stopwords removed, is issued as one PubMed query (relevance sort, top-5). If PubMed returns nothing (terms are ANDed), we relax to an OR over content words. Titles and abstracts (truncated to 1,500 characters) are given to the model.
blocks.zh: 单发RAG : 索赔,取出句子后,作为 PubMed 查询(关联类,上至5)发布. 如果 PubMed 不返回任何内容( 术语为Anded), 我们放松到 OR 上的内容单词 。 标题和摘要(共1500个字符)交给了模型.

blocks.en: Agentic search : a ReAct-style loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) in which, at each step, the model either issues a PubMed query of its own design or answers. It has a budget of 4 searches (top-5 each, deduplicated) and is told PubMed’s query semantics.
blocks.zh: Agentic search : a ReAct-tyle syle (Yao等, 2023年),其中,在每一步中,该型号要么发出自有设计的PubMed查询或回答. 它的预算为4个搜索(每个搜索上5个,被破译),并被告知PubMed的查询语义.

blocks.en: Oracle : the model receives the SciFact-cited gold abstracts directly. This upper-bounds performance given perfect retrieval and isolates reasoning over evidence.
blocks.zh: Oracle:该模型直接收到SciFact所引用的"黄金摘要". 这种上行性能给出了完美的检索并隔离了对证据的推理.

blocks.en: Backbones. We use two efficient frontier models from the same provider, gemini-3.1-flash-lite and gemini-3.5-flash-lite , chosen for their low latency and cost. Tool calls and model outputs are cached to make every number reproducible from the released logs.
blocks.zh: 后骨es. 我们使用来自同一供应商的两个高效的前沿模型,即双子座-3.1-flash-lite和双子座-3.5-flash-lite。 工具调用和模型输出被缓存,使每个数字都可以从所发布的日志中复制出.

blocks.en: Retrieval and citation diagnostics. SciFact documents are identified by Semantic Scholar IDs, not PMIDs, so we map a retrieved PubMed record to a gold document by normalized title match (exact or ratio > 0.9 >0.9 ). Gold recall is the fraction of Support / Contradict claims for which at least one gold abstract was retrieved. For retrieval conditions, a citation is unfaithful if its PMID was never returned by the tool. For closed-book citations, we check (a) existence in PubMed, (b) whether it matches a gold paper, and (c) topical relevance, judged by a model from a different family ( qwen3.8-27b ) given the claim and the cited title and abstract. We apply the same relevance judge to agent citations for comparison.
blocks.zh: 取取并引诊. SciFact文档由语义学者ID所识别,而不是PMID所识别,所以我们通过正版标题匹配(精确或比 > 0.9>0.9>0.9)将已检索的PubMed记录映射到金色文档. 黄金召回(Gold record)是支持/相矛盾的主张中至少有一个黄金抽象被取出的一部分. 对于检索条件,如果其PMID从未被工具还回,引用是不忠的. 关于封闭式引用,我们检查(a) PubMed中的存在,(b) 它是否与一纸金色纸相匹配,以及(c) 专题相关性,根据来自不同家庭(qwen3.8-27b)的模型来判断,考虑到这一主张和所引用的标题和抽象。 我们使用同样的相关判断 代理引用进行比较。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Claim verification on 100 SciFact dev claims (95% bootstrap CIs in brackets). Gold recall: fraction of Support / Contradict claims ( n = 64 n{=}64 ) for which a SciFact gold abstract was retrieved. #Searches: mean PubMed queries per claim.
blocks.zh: 表1:对100件SciFact Dev索赔的索赔核实(括号内为95% " 靴子 " CI)。 黄金召回:支持 /相矛盾索赔 (n = 64 n{=}64) 的分部分,为此取回了SciFact黄金抽象. #Searches:指每个索赔的PubMed查询.

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) Macro-F1 by harness with 95% bootstrap CIs. (b) Accuracy on Support / Contradict claims, split by whether a gold abstract was retrieved (gold-hit groups are small: n = 4 n{=}4 for RAG and n = 12 / 13 n{=}12/13 for the agent).
blocks.zh: 图1: (a) 带95%靴子CI的带子的Macro-F1。 (b) 关于支持的准确性/矛盾索赔,按是否取回了黄金抽象(受金打击的组小:RAGn = 4 n{=}4,代理商n = 12 / 13 n{=}12/13)来划分。

blocks.en: Table 1 and Figure 1 summarize the results. We highlight five findings.
blocks.zh: 表1和图1概述了结果。 我们强调五项调查结果。

blocks.en: F1: Naive one-shot retrieval does not help, and changes how the model fails. Issuing the claim itself as a PubMed query retrieves a gold abstract for only 6% of evidence-bearing claims (4/64 for both backbones). Given mostly off-target abstracts, both models abstain heavily: 59% and 70% of their predictions are NEI, against 36% NEI in the gold labels. Accuracy is unchanged or lower relative to closed-book (53.0 vs. 55.0 and 49.0 vs. 59.0; exact McNemar p = 0.89 p{=}0.89 and p = 0.24 p{=}0.24 ). Retrieval converts overconfident errors into abstentions rather than into correct verdicts. When the gold abstract was retrieved, both models were correct on all 4 such claims.
blocks.zh: F1:直径一发取回无益,并改变模型如何失败. 以PubMed查询方式发布索赔本身,只为6%的有证据的索赔(两个主干部分4/64)。 由于大多数是非目标摘要,这两个模型都投了很大的弃权票:59%和70%的预测是NEI,而黄金标签中的NEI为36%。 准确度相对于封闭本(53.0对55.0和49.0对59.0;准确的McNemar p=0.89 p{=}0.89和p=0.24 p{=}0.24)不变或较低. 检索将过度自信的错误转换为弃权而不是正确的判决. 当取回黄金摘要时,所有4项索赔的两种模型都是正确的。

blocks.en: F2: Letting the model write its own queries triples gold recall and gives the best verdicts, but the gains are modest. The agentic harness raises gold recall to 19–20% and attains the highest accuracy (62.0 for both backbones) and macro-F1 (60.3 and 61.1) of the non-oracle harnesses. Its queries are short, entity-centric reformulations (e.g., “chenodeoxycholic acid energy expenditure” instead of the full claim), and they can repair misspellings in the claim ( “Chenodeosycholic” → \rightarrow “chenodeoxycholic” ), which silently break literal retrieval. In paired comparisons, however, the improvement is not statistically significant at N = 100 N{=}100 : agent vs. single-shot, 24 vs. 15 discordant claims ( p = 0.20 p{=}0.20 ) and 29 vs. 16 ( p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 ); agent vs. closed-book, 13 vs. 6 ( p = 0.17 p{=}0.17 ) and 11 vs. 8 ( p = 0.65 p{=}0.65 ). The direction is consistent across both backbones.
blocks.zh: F2:让模型自己写出三重回金的查询,给出最好的判断,但收益不大. 干燥绳将黄金召回率提高到19-20%,并达到最高精度(骨干两端为62.0)和非甲状腺绳的宏观-F1(60.3和61.1)。 它的询问是简短的、以实体为中心的重构(例如,“环氧核酸能源支出”而不是全部索赔),它们可以修复索赔中的误写(“环氧核酸” )-\右旋的“环氧核酸”,它静悄悄地打破了文字检索。 然而,在对等比较中,在N=100 N{=}100:代理对单发,24起对15起不和索赔(p=0.20 p{=}0.20)和29起对16起(p=0.07 p{=}0.07);代理对闭账,13起对6起(p=0.17 p{=}0.17)和11起对8起(p=0.65 p{=}0.65)中,这种改进在统计学上没有意义. 双方骨干方向一致.

blocks.en: F3: Agents under-use their search budget. Despite a budget of 4 searches, the agents issue 1.42 and 1.70 queries per claim on average and answer after a single search on 71% and 55% of claims; only 3% and 6% of claims use the full budget. Among evidence-bearing claims where the agent never saw a gold abstract, it still answered Support / Contradict correctly 75% of the time, suggesting that it draws on other relevant PubMed papers or on parametric knowledge. But it also abstains less on true NEI claims (33% and 42% NEI recall, versus 72% and 81% for single-shot). Budget use is therefore a clear axis for harness improvement, for example through a minimum-evidence criterion before answering.
blocks.zh: F3:代理商未充分利用其搜索预算. 尽管预算为4项搜索,但代理商平均每项索赔提出1.42和1.70项查询,并在对71%和55%的索赔进行一次搜索后作出答复;只有3%和6%的索赔使用全额预算。 在有证据的声称中,代理人从未看到过黄金抽象,但是它仍然正确回答支持/矛盾75%的时间,暗示它借鉴了其他相关的PubMed文件或参数化知识. 但对于NEI的真实说法,它也投了较少的弃权票(NEI召回33%和42%,而单发为72%和81%)。 因此,预算使用是改进利用情况的一个明确轴心,例如在答复之前采用最低限度的证据标准。

blocks.en: F4: Retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Given the gold abstracts, the same models reach 86.0% and 79.0% accuracy (macro-F1 85.8 and 78.6), 24 and 17 points above the best realistic harness. Unlike the differences among realistic harnesses, this gap is highly significant (agent vs. oracle, 5 vs. 29 discordant claims, p < 10 − 4 p{<}10^{-4} ; 9 vs. 26, p = 0.006 p{=}0.006 ). The oracle also restores calibrated abstention (NEI recall 78% and 86%) without sacrificing Support / Contradict accuracy, so the models reason well over evidence once they are shown the right papers.
blocks.zh: F4:检索,不是推理,是主要的瓶颈. 鉴于黄金摘要,同一模型的准确度达到86.0%和79.0%(宏-F185.8和78.6),比最现实的拉带高24和17分。 与现实的绳索之间的差异不同,这一差距非常大(代理对oracle,5 vs 29相冲突的说法,p < 10 - 4 p-{<}10^{-4};9 vs 26.,p = 0.006 p-{=}0.006 ) 。 oracle还原了已校正的弃权(NEI召回了78%和86% ) , 但没有牺牲支持/矛盾的准确性,因此模型在显示正确文件后,理由远胜于证据。

blocks.en:
F5: Closed-book citations are real papers, but almost never relevant ones. Closed-book models cited PMIDs for 97 and 80 of the 100 claims. Almost all cited PMIDs exist in PubMed (186/190 and 141/145), so existence checks would pass them. None matched a SciFact gold paper, however, and the cross-family judge rated only 1 of 186 and 2 of 141 as relevant to the claim. Typical examples: a claim about TNF- α \alpha /IL-1 and IL-6/IL-10 regulation is supported by “ [The proper eyeglasses for children] ”, and a claim about headache and cognitive impairment by “ Improving access to appointments at Laurie Pike Health Centre ”. The judge itself is well calibrated on controls: it labels 21/25 gold abstracts relevant and 0/25 mismatched gold abstracts relevant. Grounding changes this sharply. The same judge rates 66% (141/215) and 70% (128/184) of agent-cited PMIDs as relevant, and 77% and 84% of agent verdicts that cite anything cite at least one relevant paper. Agents almost never cite outside what they retrieved (0% and 2.6% of citing claims).
Closed-book models are also overconfident: they predict NEI for only 4% and 9% of claims, recovering 6% and 17% of true NEI claims, so their competitive accuracy rests entirely on Support / Contradict claims.
blocks.zh:
F5:闭页引用是真实的论文,但几乎从不相关. 在100项索赔中,97项和80项索赔是以PMID为例的。 几乎所有引用的PMID都存在于PubMed(186/190和141/145),因此存在检查会通过. 然而,没有一份与SciFact金币相符,而且跨家庭法官只将186份中的1份和141份中的2份评为与索赔有关。 典型的例子:关于TNF-α-alpha / IL-1和IL-6/IL-10规章的说法得到“[儿童的适当眼镜]”的支持;关于头痛和认知障碍的说法得到“改善Laurie Pike保健中心预约机会”的支持。 法官本身对控制进行了很好的校正:它标出21/25金摘要相关和0/25不匹配的金摘要相关. 地基变化很大。 同一法官认为,被代理人援引的私营军事和安保服务公司的相关比例为66%(141/215)和70%(128/184),77%和84%的代理人裁决引用至少一份相关文件。 代理人几乎从未在他们找到的东西之外引用(占引用索赔的0%和2.6%)。
封闭式账本模型也过于自信:它们预测NEI只有4%和9%的索赔要求,收回6%和17%的真实NEI索赔要求,因此其竞争准确性完全取决于支持/矛盾索赔要求.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Implications for harness design. (1) Query formulation appears to be where the model adds the most value in a literature agent: letting the LLM reformulate the query triples recall of the right paper and gives the best verdicts on both backbones, whereas passing the claim straight to the search engine does not help. (2) The largest remaining headroom lies in retrieval, as the 17–24 point gap to the oracle shows, so iterative search that is actually used (F3), citation chasing, and domain retrievers are more promising than stronger verdict prompting. (3) Citations from ungrounded generation should never be surfaced, even when the IDs resolve: validating that a PMID exists is not sufficient, and relevance must be checked against the retrieved text.
blocks.zh: 利用设计的意义。 (1)查询公式似乎是模型在文献代理中增加价值最多的:让LLM重写查询三重回正文并给出两个骨干的最佳判断,而将索赔直接传递给搜索引擎则无济于事. (2)所剩最大的头室在于取回,正如17–24点与甲骨文差距所显示的,所以实际使用的迭代搜索(F3),引用追取,域取取取者比更强的判定提示更有希望. (3) 不应浮出未经证明的一代的引用,即使ID解决:验证PMID的存在是不够的,必须对照取回的文本检查相关性。

blocks.en: Limitations. This is a pilot study. N = 100 N{=}100 claims per condition gives wide confidence intervals, and none of the accuracy differences between realistic harnesses is significant. Both backbones are small, efficient models from a single provider, chosen for their low latency and cost, so results may differ for larger or open-weight models. SciFact labels are defined with respect to specific cited abstracts, whereas our harnesses search all of PubMed as of 2026. Some “errors” may therefore reflect newer or different evidence, and title-matched gold recall is a lower bound on useful retrieval. Relevance judgments come from a single LLM judge, validated only on 50 controls. We plan to scale to the full dev set, add open-weight and biomedical-specialist backbones, and study budget-forcing strategies for agentic search.
blocks.zh: 限制。 这是一个试点研究。 N = 100 N = 100 N = 100 要求每个条件都具有宽广的置信间隔,现实取景器之间的准确性差异并不显著. 两种骨干都是从单一的提供商中选取的小型高效模型,其耐久性和成本都较低,因此对于较大或开放重量模型的结果可能有所不同. SciFact标签是根据具体引用摘要来定义的,而我们从2026年起对普布迈德的所有地盘进行搜索。 因此,有些“错误者”可能反映较新的或不同的证据,而与所有权相匹配的黄金召回对于有用的检索来说是一种较低的约束。 相关判决来自单一的LLM法官,仅通过50项控制措施予以确认。 我们计划推广到全dev集,增加开放量级和生物医学专家骨干,并研究用于代理搜索的预算强制策略.

blocks.en: Reproducibility. Code, prompts, all raw model outputs, and the cached PubMed responses are available at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers . The released cache reproduces every reported number without API access.
blocks.zh: 发相相. 代码、提示、所有原始模型输出以及缓存的PubMed响应可在https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers查阅。 释放的缓存复制了没有API访问的每个已报告的号码.

blocks.en: Appendix A Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Shared task instruction. “You are a biomedical fact-checking assistant. Decide whether the scientific literature SUPPORTS the claim, CONTRADICTS it, or provides NOT ENOUGH INFO (NEI). Use NEI when the evidence does not directly address the claim.” All conditions require the JSON output {"label", "cited_pmids", "rationale"} .
blocks.zh: 共享任务指令 。 “你是生物医学实况调查助理。 决定科学文献是支持这一主张,还是提供不足的INFO(NEI)。 在证据没有直接处理索赔时使用NEI。” 所有条件都需要 JSON 输出{"标签","被引用_pmids","说明"} 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Closed-book adds: “You have no access to tools; rely on your own knowledge. If you know specific papers, cite their PubMed IDs.” Single-shot RAG adds: “Base your verdict only on the retrieved abstracts below; cite only PMIDs that appear in them.” Oracle adds: “Base your verdict only on the abstracts below.”
blocks.zh: 封闭账簿又说: “你们没有工具,只能依靠自己的知识。 如果你知道具体的证件,请引用他们的PubMed身份证。” 单枪匹马的RAG补充说:“只将你的判决放在以下检索摘要上;只引用其中出现的PMID。” Oracle又说:“只根据以下摘要判决。 “

blocks.en: Agentic search adds: “You can search PubMed. PubMed search is keyword-based (terms are ANDed), so short focused queries of 2–6 key terms work best; you may use OR and field tags like [tiab]. You have at most 4 searches.” At each step the model emits either {"action":"search","query":...} or {"action":"answer",...} . Only unseen results are shown after each search, and the model is forced to answer once the budget is exhausted.
blocks.zh: 代理搜索添加: “你可以搜索PubMed。 PubMed 搜索是基于关键词的(术语为ANDED),如此短的2–6个关键词的焦点查询效果最好;您可以使用 OR 等字段标记. 您最多需要4次搜索。” 每一步,模型都会发出{"动作":"搜索""克瑞":.}或者{"动作":"回答",. 每次搜索后只显示未见结果,一旦预算用完,模型就被迫回答.

blocks.en: Citation relevance judge ( qwen3.8-27b ): “Answer ‘yes’ only if the paper studies the specific entities and relationship in the claim (so it could plausibly support or refute it); answer ‘no’ if it is off-topic or only loosely related.”
blocks.zh: 引用相关性法官(qwen3.8-27b): " 只有在论文研究索赔中的具体实体和关系时,才回答`是'(因此可以合理地支持或反驳它);如果回答`否'是非专题的,或只是关系松散。 “

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: PubMed is accessed through NCBI E-utilities ( esearch with sort=relevance , retmax=5 ; efetch for titles and abstracts). All LLM calls use temperature 0 and JSON output mode. Every tool response and model output is cached, and the released cache reproduces all tables without API access. Experiments query live PubMed, so retrieval results reflect the index at the time of the run.
blocks.zh: PubMed通过NCBI E-用法访问(用 sort=相干性来搜索, retmax=5;取去标题和摘要). 所有LLM呼叫都使用温度0和JSON输出模式. 每个工具响应和模型输出都是被缓存的,发布的缓存复制所有没有API访问的表格. 实验查询活PubMed,因此检索结果反映了运行时的索引.
